message:
This is a version of FreeType with CPAL/COLR support being added. The OSS-Fuzz issue 42540566 is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1. Let me look at the CPAL/COLR code since that's the most recent work and likely where the bug is.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=thought>The OSS-Fuzz issue 42540566 is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in freetype2. The most recent commits are about CPAL/COLR support. Let me look at the ttcpal.c and ttcolr.c files since those are the newest additions and likely contain the bug.</｜｜DSML｜｜>
